people.name: Ashkelon
people.line: A major Philistine city, often a target of prophecy.

people.name: Gaza
people.line: Philistine city; Samson's exploits; Philip's ministry

translations.web: Baldness has come on Gaza; Ashkelon is brought to nothing, the remnant of their valley: how long will you cut yourself?
translations.bsb: The people of Gaza will shave their heads in mourning; Ashkelon will be silenced. O remnant of their valley, how long will you gash yourself?
translations.kjv: Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley: how long wilt thou cut
translations.asv: Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is brought to nought, the remnant of their valley: how long wilt thou cut thyself?
